title: Cinematic Orbit
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver a high-fidelity CONCEPT STORYBOARD of a desktop website, not a poster and not a product photograph. Show THREE distinct desktop viewport mockups stacked vertically, each wide landscape, on one tall portrait canvas, target 2048x3072. Thin quiet gutters separate the three keyframes. They depict three scroll positions of ONE continuous landing page, NOT three sections displayed simultaneously on the site. No browser/device frames, no decorative diagram arrows, no annotation labels. Each keyframe must look like a shippable complete screen.
Product Pacific Aurora, a fiction-writing and worldbuilding workspace. This is a refinement of the current successful concept; retain white book on white rectangular board as the full-page 3D subject, charcoal Geist-like tightly spaced grotesk UI, minimal wordmark, quiet gray copy and dark neutral pill action. White field #fafaf8, UI ink #272b2b, secondary #626764; no warm beige/cream backdrop, no blue UI, no gradients/glass/new navigation systems. Actual bound white hardcover, subtly textured cover, individual sheet edges, believable hinge and shadows. Existing castle's restrained teal roofs, small muted-green trees and blue water may appear only in the final keyframe. Do not invent social proof, pricing, logos, testimonials, capabilities or editable dashboards.
Reference images: 1=current opening screenshot, 2=current real reading-page screenshot, 3=current castle closing screenshot. They establish identity, content hierarchy, page-on-book mechanism and constraints, NOT an obligation to preserve rough geometry, exact camera pose or lighting. Refine their craft instead of replacing the idea.
KEYFRAME 1 / OPENING: minimal header top left "Pacific Aurora", top right "Questions" and "Sign in"; book RESTING CLOSED on white board. Prominent legible headline "Every story. A world within." and smaller "Write your book. Build everything inside it." with dark pill "Start writing". The book and board dominate the viewport without colliding with type. Visible white cover printing "A WORLD WITHIN" in restrained gray.
KEYFRAME 2 / READING HOLD: same book now open and lifted slightly; the spread dominates viewport with page edges, spine/gutter and a readable quiet margin around it. On left page large "Stay with the story." On right page black actual product text, exactly: "Writing", "A place for every chapter.", "Write your book with the world close at hand.", "Make the words yours.", "Format your manuscript, organize chapters, and keep the sentence in front of you.", "Save deliberately.", "Explicit Save, Ctrl/Cmd+S, and session drafts for recovery." This content belongs physically ON the page, never in floating cards or sidebars. Keep the right page readable and undistorted.
KEYFRAME 3 / FINAL REVEAL: same book lies OPEN on its white board; a dimensional castle world grows from the center spread. Beneath the book, outside its pages, centered large headline "The world is yours.", small "One world. As many stories as you can imagine.", and dark pill "Start writing". Leave clear contrast and spacing between castle and text; FAQ would follow beyond this viewport. No extra product sections.
Render all three screens at equal polished fidelity with excellent readable text, convincing real-time 3D-style material and deliberate responsive-web composition. This is concept art, not a claim that current code already renders this quality.
Variation: CINEMATIC ORBIT. Preserve the exact same white-book/white-board/material/color/type system, but direct an ambitious camera-led story. Strongest spatial framing of the three: large closed book diagonal in the opening lower center/right, board edge extending beyond the viewport, headline upper left with breathing room. Premium neutral directional daylight and crisp-but-soft moving-shadow potential, extremely convincing white paper and cover geometry. Reading shot settles into a stable gently angled overhead view with the open book occupying about 80 percent of width; retain every right-page text line legibly. A dramatic high curling physical sheet sweeps along the far LEFT foreground, outside the readable right-page area, providing a scale cue and a cinematic wipe, but no text collision. Finale camera pulls back and arcs slightly lower around a grand sculptural castle occupying the upper middle of the screen, on the same clearly visible open book and board. Castle has precise layered parapets, slender teal roofs, bridge arches and a small coast, more spatially ambitious than the baseline but restrained in palette. Centered invitation rests below with generous space. No glowing particles, no aurora ribbons, no unrelated motion devices. This option's energy comes from camera parallax, page scale and spatial staging, not adding ornaments. The reading pause is calm despite the movement between frames.
approval: Owner selected 3: get started, 2026-10-18. All three storyboard frames govern the continuous landing, not three separate sections.
scope: Approved refinement of the landing only on codex/frontend-design-testing. Preserve white book/board, semantic reading pages, stable reading holds, reversible camera/page choreography, castle close and FAQ. No deployment or unrelated surface changes.
